H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
H3947: to take (in the widest variety of applications)
H4687: a command, whether human or divine (collectively, the Law)
H6845: to hide (by covering over); by implication, to hoard or reserve; figuratively to deny; specifically (favorably) to protect, (unfavorably) to lurk
H854: properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.
H7181: to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken
H241: broadness. i.e. (concrete) the ear (from its form in man)
H5186: to stretch or spread out; by implication, to bend away (including moral deflection); used in a great variety of application
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H8394: intelligence; by implication, an argument; by extension, caprice
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H7121: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H1245: to search out (by any method, specifically in worship or prayer); by implication, to strive after

H995: to separate mentally (or distinguish), i.e.(generally) understand
H3374: fear (also used as infinitive); morally, reverence
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H4672: properly, to come forth to, i.e. appear or exist; transitively, to attain, i.e. find or acquire; figuratively, to occur, meet or be present
H6310: the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to
H8454: support or (by implication) ability, i.e. (direct) help, (in purpose) an undertaking, (intellectual) understanding
H4043: a shield (i.e. the small one or buckler); figuratively, a protector; also the scaly hide of the crocodile
H1980: to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)
H5341: to guard, in a good sense (to protect, maintain, obey, etc.) or a bad one (to conceal, etc.)
H734: a well-trodden road (literally or figuratively); also a caravan

H1870: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
H8104: properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.
H6664: the right (natural, moral or legal); also (abstractly) equity or (figuratively) prosperity
H4339: evenness, i.e. (figuratively) prosperity or concord; also straightness, i.e. (figuratively) rectitude (only in plural with singular sense; often adverbially)

H4570: a track (literally or figuratively); also a rampart (as circular)

H5337: to snatch away, whether in a good or a bad sense

H376: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
H1696: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
H5800: to loosen, i.e. relinquish, permit, etc.
H3212: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
H2822: the dark; hence (literally) darkness; figuratively, misery, destruction, death, ignorance, sorrow, wickedness
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H1523: properly, to spin round (under the influence of any violent emotion), i.e. usually rejoice, or (as cringing) fear
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.

H5237: strange, in a variety of degrees and applications (foreign, non-relative, adulterous, different, wonderful)
H2505: to be smooth (figuratively); by implication (as smooth stones were used for lots) to apportion or separate
H441: familiar; a friend, also gentle; hence, a bullock (as being tame; applied, although masculine, to a cow); and so, a chieftain (as notable, like neat cattle)
H5271: (only in plural collectively or emphatic form) youth, the state (juvenility) or the persons (young people)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H1285: a compact (because made by passing between pieces of flesh)
H7911: to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of, from want of memory or attention
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H4194: death (natural or violent); concretely, the dead, their place or state (hades); figuratively, pestilence, ruin
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H7496: properly, lax, i.e. (figuratively) a ghost (as dead; in plural only)
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H7725: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
H2416: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
H4616: properly, heed, i.e. purpose; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically, in order that
H7931: to reside or permanently stay (literally or figuratively)
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H8549: entire (literally, figuratively or morally); also (as noun) integrity, truth
H3498: to jut over or exceed; by implication, to excel; (intransitively) to remain or be left; causatively, to leave, cause to abound, preserve
H7563: morally wrong; concretely, an (actively) bad person

H898: to cover (with a garment); figuratively, to act covertly; by implication, to pillage
H4480: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
